title: The Five Garments of the Divine Human at Pentecost
description: The Lord goes forth as Divine Human clothed in five outer forms, and within each a full power is held — the rational complete in five degrees. At the appointed time the Lord's summons descends and the soul's hearing rises to meet it; the two join, and twenty registers are inscribed upon the twenty members of the rational — the children of the regenerated mind. The summons takes the answer up by the hand and conveys it into the height. Fifty days of holiness in which the soul fasts from the food the proprium had set on its table; from that season onward the soul is fed by Jesus the Radiance. The food it now receives is itself the Call and the Answer; the conversation between Lord and soul is the bread by which the soul lives, and the fast becomes the feast — fifty days of purification opening into a hundred days of holiness.
